findings.reported_title: Required 부위 선택 option has no operable control (non-semantic div chips)
findings.evidence_basis: Raw shared captures/action log plus frozen source; auxiliary detector/model output is not independent proof.
findings.evidence_reason: Snapshots 002/003/004/007 contain bone/boneless DIV nodes with role generic, interactive=false and a11y=null; visible text/content names are present. Step 2 changes the selected div styling through a pointer click, with no native radio-state feedback. The full final snapshot has no part INPUT nodes. Frozen source 280-287 and 591-597 provides only DIV chips and click handlers, without radio semantics, tabindex or part keyboard handlers. This establishes the seeded semantic/keyboard contract defect, not an observed assistive-device session.
findings.severity_assessment: P1 matches the key minimum for a required choice without the primary keyboard/control contract. This is source-supported blocking logic, not a recorded AT session.

factual_subclaim_flags.claim: No role/name for the part options.
factual_subclaim_flags.reason: Raw nodes have role generic and content names. Missing features are a selectable-control role, programmatic selection state and keyboard path; the core seed is valid.

limits: No keyboard walk, screen-reader speech, switch or voice-control trial exists. Keyboard failure is source-supported; real AT behavior is unobserved.
Pointer activation works; absence of native/control semantics must not be rewritten as absence of visible text or all pointer operability.
reported_limits: No keyboard walk or screen-reader session was recorded (run.json focus_walks is empty), so the conclusion rests on DOM state showing no control element and no focusable node for this group rather than on observed Tab/TalkBack behavior.

findings.reported_title: Cart quantity stepper buttons have no accessible name
findings.evidence_basis: Raw shared captures/action log plus frozen source; auxiliary detector/model output is not independent proof.
findings.evidence_reason: Snapshot 010 records minus/plus buttons with empty name and name_source=none; minus is disabled at quantity 1. Snapshot 011 after step 10 has quantity 2 and both buttons enabled, still unnamed. Source 643-650 renders only aria-hidden SVG glyphs in the buttons without aria-label, title or text. The two buttons and quantity states form one D-delivery-06 family.

support_refs.locator: both buttons enabled, name empty; qty-1-val=2

findings.severity_assessment: P2 matches the key minimum; exact speech remains unverified.
limits: Accessible-name absence is raw DOM evidence. Exact speech or assistive task blockage is not recorded.
SVG glyph geometry is separate from the 48x48 button hit area. Do not credit a second family for the second button.
reported_limits: Names are as computed by the harness accessibility data; no live screen-reader announcement was captured.

findings.reported_title: 추가 선택 row text is not tappable; only the 18x18 checkbox responds
findings.evidence_basis: Raw shared captures/action log plus frozen source; auxiliary detector/model output is not independent proof.
findings.evidence_reason: Step 5 hits the exposed cola name at the recorded point and has no feedback during 3000 ms. Snapshot 005/006 element arrays are identical and their PNG hashes are equal; focus separately moves to body, so the entire snapshot state is not identical. Step 6 hits the 18x18 input and records native false-to-true checkbox activation; viewed PNG 007 shows the check and 25,000 CTA. Source 187/301/606 defines the small input, non-LABEL row and input-only change handler. Accessible naming through aria-labelledby exists but does not activate the name span.
findings.severity_assessment: P2 matches the key minimum; no physical tremor/grip hit-rate is established.

factual_subclaim_flags.claim: The recorded persona note supports the extra-row finding.
factual_subclaim_flags.reason: The note content repeats the issue but its anchor is step 22/#pay-btn. Use the actual step-5/6 evidence, not that note as a corroborating measurement.

limits: 18x18 CSS px and label no-op are observed. Millimetres, miss probabilities and physical one-hand effort are not measurements from this recording.
The key notes the spacing exception for these 48px-pitch rows; no unconditional WCAG 2.5.8 size failure is credited.
The late persona note is anchored to step 22/#pay-btn, not the earlier row tap. It is not independent evidence; steps 5-6 and raw captures establish the core issue.
reported_limits: No physical-hand test was run. The option rows are 48 px apart, so a target-size spacing exception likely applies; no target-size standards violation is asserted here, only the observed tap behavior and the 18x18 measured interactive box.

findings.reported_title: Coupon rejection message gives only an error code, no cause or recovery hint
findings.evidence_basis: Raw shared captures/action log plus frozen source; auxiliary detector/model output is not independent proof.
findings.evidence_reason: Viewed raw PNG 018 and its JSON show preserved HANKI5000, the generic CPN-4003 rejection and a 53,000 CTA. JSON 020 shows success after HANKKI5000 correction and 48,000. Steps 16-19 record entry/application/correction/application. The input has aria-invalid and a described-by message. Source 819/825-835 chooses different reasons but always returns the same generic failure text, confirming the guidance defect.
findings.severity_assessment: Reported P3 is below the key minimum P2. The guidance judgment is supported, but human unaided recovery is not measured.

factual_subclaim_flags.claim: Recovery depended on the user noticing the typo unaided.
factual_subclaim_flags.reason: The agent replaces the text with the correct code supplied in the task/brief. That does not record a human noticing a typo or recovering unaided.

limits: Only typo/correction was exercised; expiry and minimum-order failure states were not captured.
Message strings and replacement actions are measured. Human understanding, unaided typo recognition or reduced support contact is not measured.
CPN-4003 is an observed error identifier; its internal purpose or sensitive-information exposure is not established.
reported_limits: Message wording is the fixture's; no production data on how often coupon rejection occurs was available. The error is otherwise well wired: the input carries aria-invalid=true and is described by the status region.

findings.reported_title: Sauce option labels are clipped, hiding part of the price
findings.evidence_basis: Raw shared captures/action log plus frozen source; auxiliary detector/model output is not independent proof.
findings.evidence_reason: Raw snapshot 006 records hot text full/visible width 111.77/88.98 and garlic 115.72/89.98, with horizontal clipping by their label containers and no ellipsis. Viewed raw CSS PNGs 004/006 show incomplete surcharge suffixes. Snapshot 002 shows clipping before hot selection (hot 109.53/89.98), so selection changes the extent but is not required for the defect. Source 183-185 fixes three narrow, nowrap, overflow-hidden chips with the full priced labels at 293-294.
findings.severity_assessment: Reported P2 is more urgent than key minimum P3. Clipping is measured; extra priority is a judgment, with no observed price misunderstanding or financial harm.
limits: Character suffixes depend on the captured font/rendering; no real-device font test, alternate width, zoom or text-spacing pass exists.
Clipping occurs inside chips; it is not proof of whole-page overflow. Multiple labels/states count once.
reported_limits: Font fallback in the headless capture is unverified, so the exact number of hidden characters may differ on a device; the container clipping itself is present in the captured layout and in the rendered screenshot at 360 px.
